title: Uniform probability of an affine subspace
statement: For a subspace $H$ of the $n$-dimensional binary cube and a point $a$ in that cube, define the affine subspace uniform probability to be the uniform probability that a point of the cube belongs to the affine subspace determined by $H$ and $a$.
